text:
tim: Hey folks — re-requesting review on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4823. I pushed a follow-up that addresses the config migration edge-case (env var fallthrough) and added a simple migration unit test. CI passed locally for me. Hoping to merge in the Wednesday canary window (3pm PST). Need one approval to merge — preference: squash into one commit, but I can keep history if folks prefer. PTAL when you have a minute.
maria: Quick question — if the migration fails on older instances, do we have a fast rollback path? I couldn't find a DB flag to toggle the change.
tim: Good call — I added a short rollback clause to the README and a feature-flag switch in the deployment manifest: `feature.flags.new_migration = false` will short-circuit. I also added a healthcheck that reports migration state. If you want I can send a brief ops note before merge.
jen: skimmed the diff — looks good. tiny nit: in `migration_test.py` can you add a comment explaining the mocked env ordering? otherwise lgtm from my side. :+1:
sam: I can give the final approval once jen's nit is added. I prefer squash to keep the canary log tidy, but not a blocker.
ci-bot: build 4823 — all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). https://ci.internal/builds/4823 ✅
tim: thanks — adding the one-line comment now and will push. @sam @maria if no objections I'll merge in the 3pm slot and notify ops. If anyone wants separate commits for bisectability speak now; otherwise i'll squash.
maria: no objections from me, go ahead assuming ops note gets sent. will approve after the comment is in.
jennote: (humorous aside unrelated) — please don't delete my branch too soon 😅
tim: comment added and pushed (force push). updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4823
sam: approving now. good catch on the env handling. 👍
jen: approved as well after the comment.
ci-bot: merge scheduled for 2026-03-18T15:00:00-08:00 (canary window). Merge strategy: squash.
